known_parity_gaps: GAP-runner-coverage: return_coverage true builds sesslint.report.Coverage in Python after detectors. Rust returns the coverage seam and does not construct Coverage on the successful path.
GAP-runner-profile-name: profile supplied as a str resolves through get_profile and sesslint.profiles.builtin in Python. Rust stops at the builtin seam for ProfileArg::Name.

GAP-runner-detector-profile-deps: non-empty streams call tool_pairing and other detectors that import sesslint.profiles in Python. Rust returns sesslint.profiles is not available instead of running the detector chain.
GAP-runner-executor-alias: repair.executor re-exports run_all_checks; parity vectors exercise sesslint.checks.runner.run_all_checks only.
GAP-runner-verify-delegate: verify._run_detector_checks delegates to the runner with adapter=canonical; that entry point is not this module's vector surface.
